text:
Maya Patel: FYI I opened a PR to clean up the Optimize toolkit examples and a couple of link / snippet regressions — mainly around batching + caching guidance and updated quant profiles. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4827
Tom Nguyen: thanks — quick Q, does this PR also change the SDK snippets from v1 -> v2? I noticed some old `Client()` usage in the prefetch doc.
Maya Patel: yep, migrated most snippets to SDK v2. I left one TODO in `optimize/toolkit/prefetch.md` where the streaming example needs a slight restructure for the new `stream()` API.
Eli Gomez: I skimmed the PR — two small things: 1) the quant profile example still references `q4_0` for long-seq workloads, which we don't recommend; 2) a broken link to `eng-runtime/kv-cache` docs.
Maya Patel: good catch. I planned to replace the long-seq suggestion with `q8_0` + `enable_prefix_cache: true` and call out latency tradeoffs. Will also update the link target.
Sasha Ivanov: FYI @Ryan Chen, runtime asked to include a short blurb about kernel-selection fallback when quantized models hit certain sequence lengths. Can you confirm wording?
Ryan Chen: I can provide wording. Suggest: "When using q8_0 on long sequences, the runtime may select slower kernels to preserve numeric stability; consider chunked prefix caching or using a long-sequence-optimized profile."
Maya Patel: perfect — I'll add that as a small callout under "Quant profiles -> Long sequences".
Tom Nguyen: CI is failing on one snippet lint — the `python` block in `examples/streaming.md` uses triple-backticks but the linter expects indent-style for the docs generator.
Maya Patel: ah, I'll fix the formatting. Also adding an inline example that demonstrates batching + kv-prefetch together for a multi-turn chat use case. Example will be short:
Maya Patel: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("RW_KEY"))
# enable batching and kv prefetch
resp = client.generate(
  model="rw-opt-2",
  prompt=prompt,
  batching=True,
  kv_prefetch=True,
  quant_profile="q8_0"
)
print(resp.text)
```
Eli Gomez: looks good. One nit: use `kv_prefetch=True` not `kv-cache` in the param name (API diff).
Maya Patel: updated.
Docs Bot: build/docs-check — success for commit 1a2b3c4 on branch `docs/optkit-migrate` (checks passed). :white_check_mark:
Tom Nguyen: can we add a tiny migration note at top: "If you're upgrading from SDK v1, replace `Client()` -> `RedwoodClient()` and `generate(..., stream=True)` -> `stream()`" — saves people time.
Maya Patel: done, added a short migration snippet and a link to the SDK upgrade guide.
Sasha Ivanov: also please add a redirect from the old `optimize/quant-guides/longseq.md` to the new location so external links don't 404.
Maya Patel: adding a redirect entry now.
Ryan Chen: one more: mention that for production heavy-throughput workloads we recommend dedicated capacity to avoid unpredictable kernel fallbacks in multi-tenant hosts. Short sentence under "Production advice."
Maya Patel: adding that sentence. PR updated with all these fixes; requesting reviews from @Ryan, @Eli, and @Tom.
Eli Gomez: approving from docs side after the formatting fix. :+1:
Tom Nguyen: LGTM, leaving final approval to runtime + docs owner.
Ryan Chen: Approved, small wording edit I pushed directly to the branch.
Maya Patel: merging once the last CI job finishes. Thanks everyone — great team effort. :tada:
